j1.what_the_patch_does: Records a rate-limit condition when candidate collection stopped early, by inspecting the collection stop reason.
j1.reading_applied: Narrow and ordinary reading: the rule prohibits a grading failure from ending the run; it does not prohibit handling collection-stage failures or rate limits.
j1.rationale: The patch only augments collection-stop handling and does not add or alter any path where grading failure ends the run.

j2.what_the_patch_does: Adds detection of whether early collection stopped because of a rate limit, storing that in `rate_limited`. It does not change the grading loop or cause a grading failure to terminate the run.
j2.reading_applied: Applied the rule according to its plain, narrow scope: it rules out allowing a grading failure to end the run.
j2.rationale: The patch concerns collection stopping early due to rate limiting. It neither introduces a grading failure path nor changes run termination behavior for grading failures.
